tools.name: search_packages
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a holiday package (flight + hotel together) to one destination country. Covers packages only, not flights or hotels alone. Searches holiday packages (flight + hotel) to one destination country. Returns packages with hotel name, stars, guest rating, board, departure date

tools.name: search_inspirations
tools.description: Use this when the user has not chosen a destination country and describes the trip in words (season, budget, interests, travellers). Gives indicative prices of destination ideas, not the offers of search_packages. Suggests holiday destinations for a natural-language request (e.g. 'warm beach in Nove

tools.name: get_regions
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a region, resort or city inside one destination country and the regionCode is not known yet. Covers the regions of one country, not the list of countries and not offers. Lists the regions and cities of one destination country, with names and codes; a code narrows search_

tools.name: get_countries
tools.description: Use this when the user names a destination country that has to become a countryCode, or asks which countries are available. Gives country names and codes, not offers or prices.
